editorial:
Imagine walking into a giant, fancy house where everything looks perfect, but the people inside are actually monsters. You meet Eun-yi, a sweet woman who just wants a steady job to help her family. She gets hired as a maid for a rich businessman, but things go south fast. The boss starts messing with her, and because she needs the money, she feels trapped. It starts as a slow burn, but it quickly turns into a nasty game of cat and mouse. You will feel for Eun-yi as she realizes that the wealthy family sees her as something they can just use and throw away.

The acting is top-notch and makes the tension feel real. You will hate the rich family, which is a sign the movie is working. While some parts move a bit slow, the shock value and the twists keep you glued to the screen. If you like stories about power and revenge, you should definitely check this out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture. Streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video is also a great way to see every detail of that cold, shiny mansion.
endingExplained: The ending is a total shock. Eun-yi tries to get away, but the family pushes her too far. In a final act of revenge, she kills the businessman. To make sure she does not get caught, she frames the other maid for the crime. The movie ends with the cycle starting all over again. A new maid arrives at the house, showing that the cycle of greed and pain in that home never truly stops.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about rich people getting what they deserve.
